tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas 'dir gdugs dkar can gyi rgyud nas gsungs shing*/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i mgon po legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su dkon mchog gi rten dang*/ khyad par chos skyong 'di'i sku yod na bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du yi dam gyi gtor ma sogs ji tsam dgos pa dang*/ 'di'i gtor ma nas nag dang sran nag gi phye la gzhi byas pa'i gru gsum pa sha khrag dang*/ dar nag gis brgyan pa zhig bya/ de dag gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i nyer mkho thams cad tshang bar bsham mo// de nas gdugs dkar gyi dbang thob na de'i bdag bskyed bya/ ma thob na rang gang byed kyi yi dam gyi mngon par rtogs pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ gtor ma rnams yi dam gang dang 'brel ba'i cho gas byin gyis brlab cing*/ yi dam la phul ba'i rjes su/ 'di'i gtor ma byin rlabs dran par byas la/ mdun du sum̐ las ri rab gru bzhi pa/ lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad ro dang*/ ro langs du mas gar byed pa dang*/ phan tshun du rgyug pa dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams ro la rtse zhing*/ sha khrag la rol pa/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ kaṃ ka la sogs dgra bgegs kyi ro la za zhing*/ rgyu ma drangs nas nam mkhar lding ba/ sprul pa glang gi mgon can phyogs bcur rgyug pa dang*/ ro phyed tshig pa dang*/ gsal shing la btags pa dang*/ mgo bo dang keng rus kyi dum bus khyab pa'i dbus su/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba me phung 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/

ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbus su/ gdug pa can gyi ro kha nas khrag skyugs pa gsum gyi snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag re re/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dpal mgon legs ldan nag po mched gsum khros pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gdangs shing glog ltar 'khyug pa/ smin ma g.yo zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pas tsan dan gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang*/ don snying gis gang ba'i thod pa bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang*/ sbrul nag gi chun pos do shal byas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar nag gi na bza' dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub kyis mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis 'gyings shing brjid pa/ ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i bka' nyan gyi 'khor ni/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin rnams khyung dang*/ bya rgod la sogs pa'i 'dab chags su sprul nas nam mkhar lding zhing 'khor bas steng gi gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje rnams seng ge dang*/ stag la sogs pa'i gcan gzan gyi tshogs su sprul nas 'og phyogs kyi gdon thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rngam zhing khros pa/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phen shing 'debs pas bskor bar bsam mo// de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang*/

ri rab kyi steng dang*/ dur khrod chen po so sha gling la sogs pa nas ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang gu gul dkar nag sha chen/ dug sna/ sgog skya rnams sbyar ba'i bdug spos sreg cing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ mthu chen mgon po nag po ni// mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sngon tshe shākya seng ge yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya mgon po 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag nas sngon gyi dam bcas bskul bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes brjod/ spro na/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdung bdun la sogs pa'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs zhes sogs spyi dang mthun par brjod cing dam la bzhag 'khor dang bcas pas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bh+yo/ ma hā kā la du tri bh+yo/ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭaṃ bh+yo/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas dbul/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod nas/ hūm̐/ bstan pa srung ba'i mthu stobs can// legs ldan nag po dka' thub las// zlog par byed pa'i bdag po dang*// lhan cig gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po chen po rdzu 'phrul can// legs ldan nag po sred med bu// phyag rgya chen po lnga rnams kyis// phyag byas pa la bdag bstod do// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa'i// legs ldan nag po dur khrod na// gnas par mos pa ma mo yi// tshogs kyis phyag byas khyod la 'dud// ces pas bstod/

dpal mgon legs ldan 'khor bcas rnams// sha khrag dmar gyis legs brgyan cing*// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol lo// bzlas pa byed na mgon po gsum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag re re'i mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi rgyud bskul bas gang 'dod pa'i phrin las 'bad med du sgrub par bsams la/ yi dam gyi sngags brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i rjes su/ dbus ma la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas pa la/ oṃ ma hā kā la du tri bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭa bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams gtso bor bzla zhing*/ thun mong du shā sa na ci nus bzlas la mthar mchod bstod bya/ 'dod don zhu/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med pa rnams la gshegs gsol spyi dang mthun par byas te/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni chos 'di la don du gnyer ba'i slob ma/ khams ston dge 'dun dpal bzang la sogs pas bskul ba'i ngor dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa'i gdugs dkar gyi gtor chog nas 'byung ba dang*/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba'i don/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang gi drung du thob pa bzhin/ shākya'i dge slong dpal ldan don grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs/ na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ dben pa'i gnas su byi dor byas pa'i sar/

maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i gdan la tshon spungs sngon po gsum bya/ chos 'byung gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod la sogs pa bskyed chog nas 'byung ba ltar bris pa bzhag de'i mdun du mgon po'i tsa ka li/ g.yas su dbyug pa/ g.yon du thod khrag dang phur bu/ de dag gi mdun du yi dam dang chos skyong gi gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa la sogs pa gtor chog tu bshad pa ltar bsham mo// de nas yi dam gang byed kyi bdag bskyed dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs nas yi dam la 'bul ba'i bar byas la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sum̐ las ri rab gru bzhi pa zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gtor chog ji lta ba bzhin bya ste/ spro na skong bshags la sogs pa'ang bya'o// de nas don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams bos la/ khrus byas yon phul snyims pa me tog dang bcas 'khod pa la/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon rnams dri ma med pa'i lung las 'byung ba ltar bshad la/ nges 'byung gi blo dang spro ba bskyed/ khyad par du rang re rnams kyis rten rnam par dag pa thob nas/ de la snying po blang ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig bya dgos shing*/ de yang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gal rkyen mang zhing mthun rkyen rnyed dka' bas 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa la srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la rgyud sde rin po che rnams las ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i nang nas/ 'di bya ba'i rgyud gtsug tor gdugs dkar nas gsungs pa yin zhing*/ de la gdugs dkar gyi gzungs gsum yod pa'i gsum ka nas gsungs shing*/ khyad par gdugs dkar mchog grub mar grags pa'i gleng gzhi las/ legs ldan nag po'i dka' thub zlog pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa dang*/ legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa dang*/

zhes gsungs shing*/ gzungs 'di'i 'grel pa slob dpon shū rāṅga warmas mdzad pa las lha de gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa gsungs pas dri ma med pa'i lung gis grub pa'i chos skyong yin/ de nyid bod yul 'dir rang dgar smra ba rnams la grags pa las khyad par du 'phags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bka' babs pa'i dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ brten zhing dul ba la sogs pa rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ khyad par bsnyen sgrub las su rung bar byas pa chos skyong 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob cing*/ cho ga'i tshul la mkhas pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ theg pa'i rim par rgyud sbyangs shing dbang gis smin pa dang*/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba don du gnyer ba zhig dgos/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med cing*/ dben zhing nyams dga' sgrub pa'i gnas su 'os pa zhig dgos/ nam bya ba'i dus ni/ zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu dang*/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga ste mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la bya dgos/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dngos la/ slob dpon gyis bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa yi dam gyi lha'i sgom bzlas dang*/ mdun du nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed cing gtor ma 'bul ba thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa bya ba rnams dgos pa legs par grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ rjes su gnang ba sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams bya dgos pa la/ thog mar slob dpon la yi dam gyi lha dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i yi dam lha la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ de'i 'og gi cha la dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos nas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i don du dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la rjes su gnang ba'i gzhi dgod pa dang*/ de la brten nas rjes gnang dngos bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon la gus 'dud cher byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'od kyi gong bu de yang mi dmigs te/ stong par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las sum̐ las ri rab gru bzhi pa/ zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin bya/

de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te de rnams kyi thugs ka dang*/ 'og min gyi gnas dang*/ ri rab kyi steng dang*/ dur khrod chen po so sha gling la sogs pa nas dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i sku la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rol mo'i sgra bya/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing*/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs/ ā be sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod/ des rjes su gnang ba'i gzhi dgod pa yin/ rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang rnams las/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dpal mgon mched gsum gyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs ka nas mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa byung bas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ tsa ka li la sogs mgon sku spyi bor bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yi rtags// gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni// myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur ba// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la kā ya a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang*/ mgon po mched gsum gyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs te/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du/ sogs nas/ thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa byung ba khyed rnams kyi mgrin par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi rtags// gang zhig bzung ba tsam gyis ni// nyon mongs gdug pa 'joms byed pa// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ shrī sogs/ wāka a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes brjod cing thod pa mgrin par reg tsam byas la lag pa g.yon tu gtad/ de dang 'brel bar bzlas pa'i lung bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sogs nas/ thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas 'thon te/ khyed rnams mgon por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par bsams nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs sngags gsum gyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du gzhug de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos nas/ slob dpon la me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs lan gsum dang*/ khyed rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor bzhag ste/ byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum brjod/ des khyed rnams kyi rgyud la sogs nas/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i sogs nas/ thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo tsan+dan gyi dbyug pa dpag tu med pa byung ba khyed rnams kyi snying gar thim pa mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rtags// gang zhig bzung ba tsam gyis ni// snying rje ldan zhing bdud skrag pa// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ shrī sogs nas/ tsit+ta a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes dang*/ dbyug pa snying khar reg cing lag pa g.yas su gtad de/ des khyed rnams kyi rgyud la sogs nas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mos pa mdzod/ yon tan dang phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du sogs nas/ thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bo phur bu dpag tu med pa byung bas khyed rnams la byin pas/ phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rtags// gang zhig bcangs pa tsam gyis ni// dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol byed pa// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ shrī sogs nas/ badz+ra kī la ya/ karma a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a bhi ṣiñca phaṭa/ ces dang*/ lag pa g.yas su gtad/ des khyed rnams kyi rgyud la sogs nas/ yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yon tan phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma'i steng du dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum la dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par mos nas/ dngos su slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos pas/ mgon po 'khor bcas dam tshig gi dbang gis khyed rnams kyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas 'gal rkyen sel zhing*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzad pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs/ sngags gsum gyi rjes su/ sangs rgyas/ gtsug tor dkar mo/ tsan+d+ra go mī/ gi ri wa ti/ badz+ra dak+ṣi/ shū rāṅga warma/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta dkar po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ rtse mo'i zhabs/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ rig 'dzin grags/ bla ma sher 'byung*/ bla ma ye shes/ zhang ye/ slob dpon dkon mchog tshul khrims/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/

rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ rgyal ba yon tan 'od/ rje seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rje bsod nams bzang po/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po// bla ma chos rig rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdung bdun la sogs pa'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ snyan pa dang grags pa dang*/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na ci bsam thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod pas mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod do// gsum pa rjes ni/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod dang*/ dngos grub zhu ba sogs gtor chog bzhin bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi slob ma don gnyer can dge 'dun dpal bzang la sogs pas bskul ba la brten nas/ mtshungs med bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang gi drung du ji ltar thob pa bzhin/ shākya'i dge slong dpal ldan don grub kyis e wam̐ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/

'di nyid gdugs dkar gyi dbang rjes gnang sogs nang 'brel par byed na/ dam tshig khas blangs kyi gong du byas nas/ mjug gi chos rnams lhan cig tu bya ba phyag len no// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
